purpose: Derive and independently verify the signed off-shell reduced spatial-diffeomorphism/Noether identity for the complete frozen GE06+GE07+Lambda+Y2+NL0B/GE05 action before projecting its H4 inhomogeneous coefficient and parent-equation terms. No numerical source patch or fitted normalization is permitted.

candidate_reduced_spatial_diffeomorphism.definition: Use infinitesimal arbitrary spatial relabeling xi(t,x) before applying the isotropic L=R reduction. Derive correct transformations of the two-dimensional coframe, scalar/aether/dust/bath variables from the frozen action; never assume a bath variable is scalar without checking its covariant origin.

preliminary_geometric_variations_for_sca.longitudinal_metric_density: delta L = xi partial_x L + L partial_x xi
preliminary_geometric_variations_for_sca.shift: delta b = partial_t xi + xi partial_x b - b partial_x xi
preliminary_geometric_variations_for_sca.lapse_and_transverse_scale: delta N = xi partial_x N; delta R = xi partial_x R

candidate_reduced_spatial_diffeomorphism.formal_Euler_Lagrange_identity_to_verify: E_N N_x + E_L L_x + E_R R_x + E_b b_x + sum_{other fields} E_field field_x - partial_x(L E_L - b E_b) - partial_t E_b = 0
candidate_reduced_spatial_diffeomorphism.physical_EL_from_source_rows: E_L=(E_isotropic+2 E_anisotropy)/3; this relation must be applied before assigning Noether source-row coefficients.

exact_h4_proof_obligations.continuum_action_invariance: Derive full reduced gauge variation and verify each action sector including all boundary terms and possible bath-aether projection effects. A proof of the gauge transformation law must accompany the identity.
exact_h4_proof_obligations.H4_source_coefficient: Extract precisely the mixed H4 coefficient of the complete identity using the frozen hierarchy and keep all terms proportional to background, Z10, Z20, Z11, q10/q20 and dust parent residuals.
exact_h4_proof_obligations.source_sign_and_normalization: Use the source-is-on-RHS convention of Repair37 and the exact GE05-to-GE06 residual factor 2 established in Repair32A. No fitted factor.
exact_h4_proof_obligations.source_dictionary: Give the signed contribution of each of the six H4 pieces to the independent shift, isotropic and anisotropy rows and to the on-shell parent residual terms.
exact_h4_proof_obligations.gauge_before_reduction: Perform the Noether derivation before imposing L=R and document the projection back to (L+R,L-R/2).
exact_h4_proof_obligations.continuum_vs_discrete: Separate action-level continuum identity from the existing FD8 GE06/GE07 versus FD4 GE05 M2 time derivatives, Fourier/NY2 spatial derivatives, bath quadrature and projected boundary.

outcome_routes.ACTION_AND_H4_IDENTITY_DERIVED: All sectors have verified gauge transformations, the signed complete off-shell identity is derived, and its H4 coefficient is given as an exact source-plus-parent-residual identity. License only a separately preregistered common-representation structural evaluation; NOT a Z21 science PASS.
outcome_routes.ACTION_OR_H4_IDENTITY_INCONSISTENT: The derivation yields a concrete nonzero analytic remainder after accounting for all parent/bath equations and boundary terms. Freeze the failed symbolic relation and pursue a separate theoretical version. Do not relabel earlier results.
outcome_routes.IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED: Some bath transformation, Y2 zero-set term, boundary term or H4 parent residual cannot be derived from frozen materials. Freeze the precise missing derivation and stop rather than assuming it vanishes.
